content.text: Hãy tìm hiểu chức năng Tuyển dụng của website này, gồm tuyen-dung.html và tất cả các file liên quan đi cùng với chức năng này. Tôi muốn nâng cấp Tính năng Nhập Địa điểm để thông minh và đầy đủ hơn, nó phải hiện ra list các thành phố, chọn thành phố thì sẽ ra quận, khu vực tương ứng thuộc thành phố đó. Ví dụ trong dang-tin-viec-lam.html cần phải chọn được thành phố và quận huyện tương ứng. Hay ngoài trang tuyen-dung.html, chỗ filter, không chỉ cho chọn thành phố mà còn phải có thêm dropdownlist để chọn quận huyện tương ứng. Tóm lại là tất cả những gì liên quan đến địa điểm, khu vực thì cần phải đáp ứng được thông tin thành phố và quận huyện đi kèm, bao gồm nhập vào và xuất ra. Lưu ý, ngữ cảnh website này đang là prototype frontend, tôi muốn thiết kế thật chuẩn giao diệ tính năng, để sau đó code thêm backend theo hướng dùng HTML tĩnh kết hợp với Cloudflare Functions / Workers, Supabase . Hãy trình bày lại chứng tỏ bạn hiểu ý tôi

*** Add File: tools/apply_lv3_stage17_rules.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Chặng 17 - Rule-based apply cho cụm Thông tư + Công văn."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage17-apply.json"
+OUT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage17-apply.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+
+def norm(text: str) -> str:
+    text = (text or "").lower()
+    text = "".join(ch for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text) if unicodedata.category(ch) != "Mn")
+    return text.replace("đ", "d")
+
+
+def has_any(text: str, needles: List[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(n in text for n in needles)
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_stage17", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def taxonomy_labels() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    stack = list(data.get("roots", []))
+    while stack:
+        node = stack.pop()
+        k, lb = node.get("key"), node.get("label")
+        if k and lb:
+            labels[k] = lb
+        stack.extend(node.get("children") or [])
+    return labels
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, lv3_key: str, lv3_label: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def decide_lv3(topic_lv2: str, title: str, href: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    t = norm(f"{title} {href}")
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "thong-tu":
+        has_tncn = has_any(t, ["tncn", "thu nhap ca nhan"])
+        has_tndn = has_any(t, ["tndn", "thu nhap doanh nghiep"])
+        if has_any(t, ["dang ky thue", "ma so thue", "mst"]):
+            return "thong-tu-mst-dang-ky-thue", "rule-thong-tu-mst"
+        if has_any(t, ["thu tuc hanh chinh ve thue", "quan ly thue", "ke khai"]):
+            return "thong-tu-ke-khai-quan-ly-thue", "rule-thong-tu-ke-khai"
+        if has_tncn and has_tndn:
+            return "thong-tu-ke-khai-quan-ly-thue", "rule-thong-tu-mix-tncn-tndn"
+        if has_any(t, ["gtgt", "hoa don", "ttdb"]):
+            return "thong-tu-gtgt-hoa-don", "rule-thong-tu-gtgt"
+        if has_tndn:
+            return "thong-tu-tndn", "rule-thong-tu-tndn"
+        if has_tncn:
+            return "thong-tu-tncn", "rule-thong-tu-tncn"
+        if has_any(t, ["lao dong", "bldtbxh", "bhxh", "tien luong"]):
+            return "thong-tu-chinh-sach-chung", "rule-thong-tu-chinh-sach"
+        if has_any(t, ["ho kinh doanh", "ca nhan kinh doanh"]):
+            return "thong-tu-ho-ca-nhan-kinh-doanh", "rule-thong-tu-ho-ca-nhan"
+        if has_any(
+            t,
+            [
+                "ke toan doanh nghiep",
+                "thong tu 200",
+                "tt 200",
+                "bctc hop nhat",
+                "tai san co dinh",
+                "ke toan nha nuoc",
+                "chuyen khoan",
+            ],
+        ):
+            return "thong-tu-chinh-sach-chung", "rule-thong-tu-ke-toan-chung"
+        return "", "no-match-thong-tu"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "cong-van":
+        if has_any(t, ["dang ky thue", "ke khai thue", "htkk", "gia han nop thue", "covid", "thue", "tct-kk", "tct-cs", "tct-qln"]):
+            return "cong-van-ke-khai-quan-ly-thue", "rule-cong-van-thue"
+        if has_any(t, ["lao dong", "luong toi thieu", "cong tac phi", "bhxh", "thang bang luong", "cdkt", "thong tu 200", "bo tai chinh"]):
+            return "cong-van-chinh-sach-chung", "rule-cong-van-chinh-sach"
+        return "", "no-match-cong-van"
+
+    return "", "unsupported-topic-lv2"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    labels = taxonomy_labels()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+
+    targets = [
+        a
+        for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs
+        and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and (a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") in {"thong-tu", "cong-van"}
+        and not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip()
+    ]
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for a in targets:
+        lv3_key, reason = decide_lv3(a.get("topicLv2Key") or "", a.get("title") or "", a.get("href") or "")
+        if not lv3_key:
+            skipped.append({"href": a.get("href"), "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"), "reason": reason})
+            continue
+        a["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+        a["topicLv3Label"] = labels.get(lv3_key) or ""
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": a.get("href"),
+                "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"),
+                "topicLv3Key": lv3_key,
+                "topicLv3Label": a.get("topicLv3Label"),
+                "reason": reason,
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+
+    meta_updated = 0
+    meta_skipped = []
+    for row in applied:
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / row["href"], row["topicLv3Key"], row["topicLv3Label"])
+        if ok:
+            meta_updated += 1
+        else:
+            meta_skipped.append({"href": row["href"], "reason": reason})
+
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "scope": {"targets": len(targets), "applied": len(applied), "skipped": len(skipped)},
+        "articleMetaUpdated": meta_updated,
+        "articleMetaSkipped": meta_skipped,
+        "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+        "appliedRows": applied,
+        "skippedRows": skipped,
+    }
+    OUT_JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Chặng 17 - Apply rule cho cụm Thông tư + Công văn",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Targets: **{len(targets)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Cập nhật article-meta HTML: **{meta_updated}**",
+        "",
+        "## Quy mô sau rebuild",
+        "",
+        f"- Thư viện: {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang",
+        f"- Bản tin: {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Danh sách applied",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | lv2 | lv3 | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{row['topicLv2Key']}` | `{row['topicLv3Key']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    lines += ["", "## Danh sách skipped", "", "| # | href | lv2 | reason |", "|---:|---|---|---|"]
+    for i, row in enumerate(skipped, 1):
+        lines.append(f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{row['topicLv2Key']}` | `{row['reason']}` |")
+
+    OUT_MD_PATH.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "targets": len(targets),
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "articleMetaUpdated": meta_updated,
+                "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+                "applyLog": str(OUT_JSON_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage18-apply.json"
+OUT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage18-apply.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+
+def norm(text: str) -> str:
+    text = (text or "").lower()
+    text = "".join(ch for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text) if unicodedata.category(ch) != "Mn")
+    return text.replace("đ", "d")
+
+
+def has_any(text: str, needles: List[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(n in text for n in needles)
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_stage18", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def taxonomy_labels() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    stack = list(data.get("roots", []))
+    while stack:
+        node = stack.pop()
+        k, lb = node.get("key"), node.get("label")
+        if k and lb:
+            labels[k] = lb
+        stack.extend(node.get("children") or [])
+    return labels
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, lv3_key: str, lv3_label: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def decide_lv3(topic_lv2: str, title: str, href: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    t = norm(f"{title} {href}")
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "gtgt-hoa-don":
+        if has_any(t, ["phat hanh hoa don", "su dung hoa don", "noi dung hoa don", "lap hoa don", "xu ly hoa don", "hoa don gtgt"]):
+            return "lap-xu-ly-hoa-don", "rule-gtgt-lap-xu-ly-hoa-don"
+        if has_any(t, ["thue suat", "luat thue gia tri gia tang", "doi tuong ke khai gtgt", "ke khai thue gtgt", "giam thue gtgt"]):
+            return "thue-suat-doi-tuong", "rule-gtgt-thue-suat-doi-tuong"
+        if has_any(t, ["bao cao thue", "to khai thue", "bang ke"]):
+            return "bao-cao-bang-ke", "rule-gtgt-bao-cao-bang-ke"
+        return "", "no-match-gtgt"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "bao-hiem":
+        if has_any(t, ["che do thai san", "01b-hsb", "c70a-hd", "duong suc", "om dau"]):
+            return "che-do-muc-huong", "rule-bh-che-do"
+        if has_any(t, ["tk1-ts"]):
+            return "ho-so-thu-tuc", "rule-bh-ho-so-tk1-ts"
+        if has_any(t, ["quyet dinh 959", "quyet dinh 1040", "ty le dong bhxh", "muc dong bhxh"]):
+            return "doi-tuong-muc-dong", "rule-bh-doi-tuong-muc-dong"
+        if has_any(t, ["muc phat", "khai sai"]):
+            return "vi-pham-xu-phat", "rule-bh-vi-pham"
+        if has_any(t, ["phu cap", "dien thoai", "phuc loi"]):
+            return "hach-toan-chi-phi-bao-hiem", "rule-bh-hach-toan-phu-cap"
+        if has_any(t, ["bao hiem that nghiep"]):
+            return "van-ban-chinh-sach", "rule-bh-chinh-sach"
+        return "", "no-match-bao-hiem"
+
+    return "", "unsupported-topic-lv2"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    labels = taxonomy_labels()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+
+    targets = [
+        a
+        for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs
+        and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and (a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") in {"gtgt-hoa-don", "bao-hiem"}
+        and not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip()
+    ]
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for a in targets:
+        lv3_key, reason = decide_lv3(a.get("topicLv2Key") or "", a.get("title") or "", a.get("href") or "")
+        if not lv3_key:
+            skipped.append({"href": a.get("href"), "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"), "reason": reason})
+            continue
+        a["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+        a["topicLv3Label"] = labels.get(lv3_key) or ""
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": a.get("href"),
+                "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"),
+                "topicLv3Key": lv3_key,
+                "topicLv3Label": a.get("topicLv3Label"),
+                "reason": reason,
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+
+    meta_updated = 0
+    meta_skipped = []
+    for row in applied:
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / row["href"], row["topicLv3Key"], row["topicLv3Label"])
+        if ok:
+            meta_updated += 1
+        else:
+            meta_skipped.append({"href": row["href"], "reason": reason})
+
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "scope": {"targets": len(targets), "applied": len(applied), "skipped": len(skipped)},
+        "articleMetaUpdated": meta_updated,
+        "articleMetaSkipped": meta_skipped,
+        "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+        "appliedRows": applied,
+        "skippedRows": skipped,
+    }
+    OUT_JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Chặng 18 - Apply rule cho cụm GTGT/Hóa đơn + Bảo hiểm",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Targets: **{len(targets)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Cập nhật article-meta HTML: **{meta_updated}**",
+        "",
+        "## Quy mô sau rebuild",
+        "",
+        f"- Thư viện: {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang",
+        f"- Bản tin: {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Danh sách applied",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | lv2 | lv3 | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{row['topicLv2Key']}` | `{row['topicLv3Key']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    lines += ["", "## Danh sách skipped", "", "| # | href | lv2 | reason |", "|---:|---|---|---|"]
+    for i, row in enumerate(skipped, 1):
+        lines.append(f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{row['topicLv2Key']}` | `{row['reason']}` |")
+
+    OUT_MD_PATH.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "targets": len(targets),
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "articleMetaUpdated": meta_updated,
+                "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+                "applyLog": str(OUT_JSON_PATH.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Chặng 19 - Apply batch rule hỗn hợp cho các cụm dễ còn lại."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+INPUT_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage19-batch1-candidates.apply.json"
+OUT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage19-batch1-apply.json"
+OUT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage19-batch1-apply.md"
+FINAL_SUMMARY_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.md"
+FINAL_SUMMARY_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.json"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_stage19", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def taxonomy_labels() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    stack = list(data.get("roots", []))
+    while stack:
+        n = stack.pop()
+        k, lb = n.get("key"), n.get("label")
+        if k and lb:
+            labels[k] = lb
+        stack.extend(n.get("children") or [])
+    return labels
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, lv3_key: str, lv3_label: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def write_final_summary(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> None:
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+    imported_rows = [a for a in data_articles if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs]
+
+    total = len(imported_rows)
+    non_empty = sum(1 for a in imported_rows if (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip())
+    empty = total - non_empty
+    coverage = round((non_empty / total) * 100, 2) if total else 0.0
+
+    from collections import Counter
+
+    remaining = [a for a in imported_rows if not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip() and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"]
+    by_lv2 = Counter((a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") for a in remaining)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "imported745": {"total": total, "topicLv3NonEmpty": non_empty, "topicLv3Empty": empty, "coveragePercent": coverage},
+        "remainingThuVienByLv2": dict(by_lv2),
+    }
+    FINAL_SUMMARY_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Tổng kết tiến độ gán LV3 cho 745 bài import",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian cập nhật: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Tổng bài import: **{total}**",
+        f"- Đã có topicLv3: **{non_empty}**",
+        f"- Còn trống topicLv3: **{empty}**",
+        f"- Coverage: **{coverage}%**",
+        "",

Em hiểu rất rõ ý anh, tóm tắt lại như sau:

## 1) Mục tiêu anh muốn
Nâng cấp toàn bộ tính năng **địa điểm/khu vực** trong module Tuyển dụng để dùng chuẩn:
- **Tỉnh/Thành phố** → rồi mới chọn **Quận/Huyện/Khu vực** phụ thuộc theo tỉnh/thành đã chọn.
- Không chỉ phần **nhập dữ liệu**, mà cả phần **lọc**, **hiển thị**, và **dữ liệu xuất ra** đều phải đồng bộ theo cấu trúc này.

## 2) Phạm vi anh yêu cầu
Không chỉ `tuyen-dung.html`, mà **tất cả file liên quan** tới flow tuyển dụng đều phải áp dụng chuẩn location 2 tầng, gồm các trang chính em đã rà:
- `tuyen-dung.html` (lọc job list)
- `dang-tin-viec-lam.html` (form đăng tin)
- `dang-tin-tuyen-dung.html` (form tuyển dụng)
- `ho-so-ung-vien.html` (địa điểm mong muốn ứng viên)
- `danh-sach-ung-vien.html` (lọc ứng viên)
- `quan-ly-tin-tuyen-dung.html` (lọc quản lý tin)
- `ung-vien-tuyen-dung.html` (lọc ứng viên phía NTD)

Và các file logic dùng chung:
- `assets/js/vn-location-data.js` (data tỉnh/thành + quận/huyện/khu vực)
- `assets/js/jobs-location-picker.js` (engine đổ dropdown phụ thuộc và map dữ liệu)

## 3) Kết quả anh kỳ vọng
- Ở các form (ví dụ `dang-tin-viec-lam.html`): bắt buộc chọn đúng **Tỉnh/Thành** và **Quận/Huyện** tương ứng.
- Ở các trang filter (ví dụ `tuyen-dung.html`): có cả 2 dropdown, chọn tỉnh thì list quận/huyện đổi theo.
- Dữ liệu location phải nhất quán từ đầu vào đến đầu ra:  
  `provinceKey/provinceName` + `areaKey/areaName` + chuỗi hiển thị địa điểm.

## 4) Ràng buộc kỹ thuật anh đặt
Website đang là **prototype frontend**, nên cần thiết kế giao diện/luồng dữ liệu thật chuẩn ngay từ bây giờ để sau đó gắn backend theo hướng:
- HTML tĩnh
- Cloudflare Functions/Workers
- Supabase

---

Nếu anh xác nhận đúng ý, bước tiếp theo em sẽ đưa luôn **spec chuẩn UI + data contract + checklist triển khai từng file** để dev backend cắm vào không phải sửa lại structure.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Chặng 20 - Rule-based apply cho cụm pháp lý + nghị quyết + phần dư dễ."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage20-apply.json"
+OUT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage20-apply.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+
+def norm(text: str) -> str:
+    text = (text or "").lower()
+    text = "".join(ch for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text) if unicodedata.category(ch) != "Mn")
+    return text.replace("đ", "d")
+
+
+def has_any(text: str, needles: List[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(n in text for n in needles)
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_stage20", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def taxonomy_labels() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    stack = list(data.get("roots", []))
+    while stack:
+        node = stack.pop()
+        k, lb = node.get("key"), node.get("label")
+        if k and lb:
+            labels[k] = lb
+        stack.extend(node.get("children") or [])
+    return labels
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, lv3_key: str, lv3_label: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def decide_lv3(topic_lv2: str, title: str, href: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    t = norm(f"{title} {href}")
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "luat-bo-luat":
+        if has_any(t, ["bo luat lao dong"]):
+            return "luat-lao-dong", "rule-luat-lao-dong"
+        if has_any(t, ["bao hiem xa hoi"]):
+            return "luat-bhxh", "rule-luat-bhxh"
+        if has_any(t, ["bao hiem y te"]):
+            return "luat-bhyt", "rule-luat-bhyt"
+        if has_any(t, ["luat viec lam"]):
+            return "luat-viec-lam", "rule-luat-viec-lam"
+        if has_any(t, ["luat ke toan"]):
+            return "luat-ke-toan", "rule-luat-ke-toan"
+        if has_any(t, ["luat doanh nghiep"]):
+            return "luat-doanh-nghiep", "rule-luat-doanh-nghiep"
+        if has_any(t, ["xuat khau", "nhap khau"]):
+            return "luat-thue-xuat-nhap-khau", "rule-luat-xnk"
+        if has_any(t, ["quan ly thue"]):
+            return "luat-quan-ly-thue", "rule-luat-quan-ly-thue"
+        if has_any(t, ["thue gtgt"]):
+            return "luat-thue-gtgt", "rule-luat-gtgt"
+        if has_any(t, ["cac luat ve thue", "cac luat thue", "sua doi bo sung cac luat"]):
+            return "luat-quan-ly-thue", "rule-luat-chung-ve-thue"
+        return "", "no-match-luat-bo-luat"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "nghi-quyet-quyet-dinh":
+        if has_any(t, ["giam tru gia canh", "thue tncn"]):
+            return "nq-thue-tncn-giam-tru-hoan-thue", "rule-nq-tncn"
+        if has_any(t, ["giam thue gtgt", "xuong 8"]):
+            return "nq-thue-gtgt-giam-thue", "rule-nq-gtgt"
+        if has_any(t, ["giam thue tndn"]):
+            return "nq-thue-tndn-giam-thue", "rule-nq-tndn"
+        return "", "no-match-nghi-quyet"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "mau-bieu-doanh-nghiep-thu-tuc":
+        if has_any(t, ["bien lai thu tien"]):
+            return "mau-hoa-don-chung-tu", "rule-mau-bien-lai-thu-tien"
+        if has_any(t, ["thong tu 68", "dang ky doanh nghiep ho kinh doanh", "ho kinh doanh"]):
+            return "mau-ho-ca-nhan-kinh-doanh", "rule-mau-thong-tu-68-ho-kd"
+        return "", "no-match-mau-bieu-dn-thu-tuc"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "cong-van":
+        if has_any(t, ["thong-tu-09-2015", "gop von phai chuyen khoan"]):
+            return "cong-van-chinh-sach-chung", "rule-cong-van-misfiled-thong-tu"
+        return "", "no-match-cong-van"
+
+    return "", "unsupported-topic-lv2"
+
+
+def write_final_summary(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> None:
+    final_md = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.md"
+    final_json = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.json"
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+    imported_rows = [a for a in data_articles if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs]
+
+    total = len(imported_rows)
+    non_empty = sum(1 for a in imported_rows if (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip())
+    empty = total - non_empty
+    coverage = round((non_empty / total) * 100, 2) if total else 0.0
+
+    from collections import Counter
+
+    remaining = [a for a in imported_rows if not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip() and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"]
+    by_lv2 = Counter((a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") for a in remaining)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "imported745": {"total": total, "topicLv3NonEmpty": non_empty, "topicLv3Empty": empty, "coveragePercent": coverage},
+        "remainingThuVienByLv2": dict(by_lv2),
+    }
+    final_json.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Tổng kết tiến độ gán LV3 cho 745 bài import",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian cập nhật: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Tổng bài import: **{total}**",
+        f"- Đã có topicLv3: **{non_empty}**",
+        f"- Còn trống topicLv3: **{empty}**",
+        f"- Coverage: **{coverage}%**",
+        "",
+        "## Còn trống theo LV2 (Thu viện)",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for k, v in by_lv2.most_common():
+        lines.append(f"- `{k}`: {v}")
+    final_md.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    labels = taxonomy_labels()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+
+    target_lv2 = {"luat-bo-luat", "nghi-quyet-quyet-dinh", "mau-bieu-doanh-nghiep-thu-tuc", "cong-van"}
+    targets = [
+        a
+        for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs
+        and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and (a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") in target_lv2
+        and not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip()
+    ]
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for a in targets:
+        lv3_key, reason = decide_lv3(a.get("topicLv2Key") or "", a.get("title") or "", a.get("href") or "")
+        if not lv3_key:
+            skipped.append({"href": a.get("href"), "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"), "reason": reason})
+            continue
+        a["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+        a["topicLv3Label"] = labels.get(lv3_key) or ""
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": a.get("href"),
+                "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"),
+                "topicLv3Key": lv3_key,
+                "topicLv3Label": a.get("topicLv3Label"),
+                "reason": reason,
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+
+    meta_updated = 0

+    for row in applied:
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / row["href"], row["topicLv3Key"], row["topicLv3Label"])
+        if ok:

+        else:
+            meta_skipped.append({"href": row["href"], "reason": reason})
+
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+    write_final_summary(data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "scope": {"targets": len(targets), "applied": len(applied), "skipped": len(skipped)},
+        "articleMetaUpdated": meta_updated,
+        "articleMetaSkipped": meta_skipped,

+        "skippedRows": skipped,
+    }
+    OUT_JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Chặng 20 - Apply rule cụm pháp lý + nghị quyết + phần dư dễ",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",

+

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Chặng 21 - Rule-based apply cho cụm Thu tục DN + Kinh nghiệm/Hỏi đáp."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage21-apply.json"
+OUT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage21-apply.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+
+def norm(text: str) -> str:
+    text = (text or "").lower()
+    text = "".join(ch for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text) if unicodedata.category(ch) != "Mn")
+    return text.replace("đ", "d")
+
+
+def has_any(text: str, needles: List[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(n in text for n in needles)
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_stage21", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def taxonomy_labels() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    stack = list(data.get("roots", []))
+    while stack:
+        node = stack.pop()
+        k, lb = node.get("key"), node.get("label")
+        if k and lb:
+            labels[k] = lb
+        stack.extend(node.get("children") or [])
+    return labels
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, lv3_key: str, lv3_label: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def decide_lv3(topic_lv2: str, title: str, href: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    t = norm(f"{title} {href}")
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "thu-tuc-doanh-nghiep":
+        if has_any(t, ["ho tro doanh nghiep nho va vua", "nghi dinh 39", "nghi dinh 80", "bo nhiem ke toan truong"]):
+            return "dn-thu-tuc-quan-tri-ho-tro", "rule-thu-tuc-quan-tri-ho-tro"
+        if has_any(t, ["xu ly tien phat", "vi pham hop dong kinh te"]):
+            return "dn-thu-tuc-khuyen-mai-thuong-mai", "rule-thu-tuc-khuyen-mai-thuong-mai"
+        if has_any(
+            t,
+            [
+                "tscd",
+                "tai san co dinh",
+                "khau hao",
+                "hach toan",
+                "tai khoan 821",
+                "tai khoan 153",
+                "thue thu nhap doanh nghiep",
+                "doanh thu de tinh thu nhap chiu thue",
+                "nguyen tac ke toan",
+                "von chu so huu",
+                "he thong so sach ke toan",
+                "dat in va thong bao phat hanh hoa don",
+            ],
+        ):
+            return "dn-thu-tuc-tai-chinh-vay-von", "rule-thu-tuc-tai-chinh-vay-von"
+        return "", "no-match-thu-tuc-doanh-nghiep"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "kinh-nghiem-hoi-dap-nghe-nghiep":
+        if has_any(t, ["cach lap the tinh gia thanh san pham", "thong tu 200", "tt 200", "thong tu 133"]):
+            return "hoc-va-dao-tao-ke-toan", "rule-kinh-nghiem-hoc-dao-tao"
+        if has_any(
+            t,
+            [
+                "to khai thue",
+                "bang ke",
+                "hoa don",
+                "le phi truoc ba",
+                "ca nhan cu tru",
+                "nguoi nop thue",
+                "nop tien vao ngan sach",
+                "thue cua to chuc khai thay",
+                "bien ban xac minh tinh trang hoat dong",
+            ],
+        ):
+            return "kinh-nghiem-quyet-toan-thue", "rule-kinh-nghiem-quyet-toan-thue"
+        return "", "no-match-kinh-nghiem"
+
+    return "", "unsupported-topic-lv2"
+
+
+def write_final_summary(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> None:
+    final_md = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.md"
+    final_json = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.json"
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+    imported_rows = [a for a in data_articles if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs]
+
+    total = len(imported_rows)
+    non_empty = sum(1 for a in imported_rows if (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip())
+    empty = total - non_empty
+    coverage = round((non_empty / total) * 100, 2) if total else 0.0
+
+    from collections import Counter
+
+    remaining = [a for a in imported_rows if not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip() and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"]
+    by_lv2 = Counter((a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") for a in remaining)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "imported745": {"total": total, "topicLv3NonEmpty": non_empty, "topicLv3Empty": empty, "coveragePercent": coverage},
+        "remainingThuVienByLv2": dict(by_lv2),
+    }
+    final_json.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Tổng kết tiến độ gán LV3 cho 745 bài import",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian cập nhật: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Tổng bài import: **{total}**",
+        f"- Đã có topicLv3: **{non_empty}**",
+        f"- Còn trống topicLv3: **{empty}**",
+        f"- Coverage: **{coverage}%**",
+        "",
+        "## Còn trống theo LV2 (Thu viện)",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for k, v in by_lv2.most_common():
+        lines.append(f"- `{k}`: {v}")
+    final_md.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    labels = taxonomy_labels()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+
+    target_lv2 = {"thu-tuc-doanh-nghiep", "kinh-nghiem-hoi-dap-nghe-nghiep"}
+    targets = [
+        a
+        for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs
+        and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and (a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") in target_lv2
+        and not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip()
+    ]
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for a in targets:
+        lv3_key, reason = decide_lv3(a.get("topicLv2Key") or "", a.get("title") or "", a.get("href") or "")
+        if not lv3_key:
+            skipped.append({"href": a.get("href"), "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"), "reason": reason})
+            continue
+        a["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+        a["topicLv3Label"] = labels.get(lv3_key) or ""
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": a.get("href"),
+                "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"),
+                "topicLv3Key": lv3_key,
+                "topicLv3Label": a.get("topicLv3Label"),
+                "reason": reason,
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+
+    meta_updated = 0
+    meta_skipped = []
+    for row in applied:
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / row["href"], row["topicLv3Key"], row["topicLv3Label"])
+        if ok:
+            meta_updated += 1
+        else:
+            meta_skipped.append({"href": row["href"], "reason": reason})
+
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+    write_final_summary(data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "scope": {"targets": len(targets), "applied": len(applied), "skipped": len(skipped)},
+        "articleMetaUpdated": meta_updated,
+        "articleMetaSkipped": meta_skipped,
+        "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+        "appliedRows": applied,
+        "skippedRows": skipped,
+    }
+    OUT_JSON_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Chặng 21 - Apply rule cụm Thu tục DN + Kinh nghiệm/Hỏi đáp",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Targets: **{len(targets)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Cập nhật article-meta HTML: **{meta_updated}**",
+        "",
+        "## Quy mô sau rebuild",
+        "",

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: tools/apply_lv3_stage22_rules.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Chặng 22 - Apply nhỏ, an toàn cao cho các bài còn lại."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage22-apply.json"
+OUT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage22-apply.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+
+def norm(text: str) -> str:
+    text = (text or "").lower()
+    text = "".join(ch for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text) if unicodedata.category(ch) != "Mn")
+    return text.replace("đ", "d")
+
+
+def has_any(text: str, needles: List[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(n in text for n in needles)
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_stage22", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def taxonomy_labels() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    stack = list(data.get("roots", []))
+    while stack:
+        n = stack.pop()
+        k, lb = n.get("key"), n.get("label")
+        if k and lb:
+            labels[k] = lb
+        stack.extend(n.get("children") or [])
+    return labels
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, lv3_key: str, lv3_label: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def decide_lv3(topic_lv2: str, title: str, href: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    t = norm(f"{title} {href}")
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "tai-khoan-hach-toan":
+        if has_any(t, ["so chi tiet cac tai khoan"]):
+            return "hach-toan-dac-thu", "rule-tk-so-chi-tiet-tai-khoan"
+        if has_any(t, ["chua duoc thanh toan", "mau 01/tcn", "mau-01-tcn"]):
+            return "cong-no-thanh-toan", "rule-tk-cong-no-thanh-toan"
+        if has_any(t, ["mau 01/bds", "mau-01-bds", "to khai thue cho thue nha"]):
+            return "thue-nghia-vu", "rule-tk-thue-nghia-vu"
+        if has_any(t, ["mau giay di duong"]):
+            return "hach-toan-dac-thu", "rule-tk-giay-di-duong"
+        return "", "no-match-tai-khoan-hach-toan"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "thu-tuc-doanh-nghiep":
+        if has_any(t, ["duoc lo trong may nam", "bao lo may nam"]):
+            return "dn-thu-tuc-tai-chinh-vay-von", "rule-thu-tuc-lo-luy-ke"
+        return "", "no-match-thu-tuc-doanh-nghiep"
+
+    if topic_lv2 == "gtgt-hoa-don":
+        if has_any(t, ["tieu thu dac biet", "ttdb"]):
+            return "thue-suat-doi-tuong", "rule-gtgt-ttdb-thue-suat"
+        return "", "no-match-gtgt"
+
+    return "", "unsupported-topic-lv2"
+
+
+def write_final_summary(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> None:
+    final_md = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.md"
+    final_json = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.json"
+    import_log = json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "update-800-bai-import-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported_hrefs = {item["target_path"] for b in import_log.get("batches", []) for item in b.get("imported", [])}
+    imported_rows = [a for a in data_articles if a.get("href") in imported_hrefs]
+
+    total = len(imported_rows)
+    non_empty = sum(1 for a in imported_rows if (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip())
+    empty = total - non_empty
+    coverage = round((non_empty / total) * 100, 2) if total else 0.0
+
+    from collections import Counter
+
+    remaining = [a for a in imported_rows if not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip() and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"]
+    by_lv2 = Counter((a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") for a in remaining)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "imported745": {"total": total, "topicLv3NonEmpty": non_empty, "topicLv3Empty": empty, "coveragePercent": coverage},
+        "remainingThuVienByLv2": dict(by_lv2),
+    }
+    final_json.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Tổng kết tiến độ gán LV3 cho 745 bài import",
+        "",

+

+    skipped = []

+        lv3_key, reason = decide_lv3(a.get("topicLv2Key") or "", a.get("title") or "", a.get("href") or "")
+        if not lv3_key:
+            skipped.append({"href": a.get("href"), "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"), "reason": reason})

+        a["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+        a["topicLv3Label"] = labels.get(lv3_key) or ""
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": a.get("href"),
+                "topicLv2Key": a.get("topicLv2Key"),
+                "topicLv3Key": lv3_key,
+                "topicLv3Label": a.get("topicLv3Label"),
+                "reason": reason,
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)

+    meta_updated = 0
+    meta_skipped = []
+    for row in applied:
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / row["href"], row["topicLv3Key"], row["topicLv3Label"])
+        if ok:

+        else:
+            meta_skipped.append({"href": row["href"], "reason": reason})

+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+    write_final_summary(data_articles)

+    payload = {

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Chặng 23 - Apply rất bảo thủ + đóng gói queue review tay cuối."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage23-apply.json"
+OUT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage23-apply.md"
+REVIEW_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage23-manual-review.json"
+REVIEW_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage23-manual-review.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+
+def norm(text: str) -> str:
+    text = (text or "").lower()
+    text = "".join(ch for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text) if unicodedata.category(ch) != "Mn")
+    return text.replace("đ", "d")
+
+
+def has_any(text: str, needles: List[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(n in text for n in needles)
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_stage23", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def taxonomy_labels() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    stack = list(data.get("roots", []))
+    while stack:
+        node = stack.pop()
+        k, lb = node.get("key"), node.get("label")
+        if k and lb:
+            labels[k] = lb
+        stack.extend(node.get("children") or [])
+    return labels
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, lv3_key: str, lv3_label: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def decide_lv3(topic_lv2: str, title: str, href: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    """Rule rất chặt: chỉ gán khi gần như chắc chắn theo ngữ nghĩa hiện tại."""
+    t = norm(f"{title} {href}")
+    if topic_lv2 == "gtgt-hoa-don" and has_any(t, ["bang thue xuat khau"]):
+        return "thue-suat-doi-tuong", "rule-gtgt-bang-thue-xuat-khau"
+    return "", "no-safe-match-stage23"
+
+
+def suggest_manual_action(article: Dict) -> Dict:
+    """Đưa gợi ý review tay (không tự động áp dụng)."""
+    lv2 = article.get("topicLv2Key") or ""
+    href = article.get("href") or ""
+    title = article.get("title") or ""
+    t = norm(f"{title} {href}")
+
+    suggestion = {
+        "href": href,
+        "title": title,
+        "currentTopicLv2Key": lv2,
+        "suggestedTopicLv2Key": "",
+        "suggestedTopicLv3Key": "",
+        "confidence": "low",
+        "note": "Cần review tay",
+    }
+
+    if lv2 == "kinh-nghiem-hoi-dap-nghe-nghiep":
+        if has_any(t, ["hoi cho", "trien lam thuong mai", "mau 10", "mau 13", "mau 14"]):
+            suggestion.update(
+                {
+                    "suggestedTopicLv2Key": "mau-bieu-doanh-nghiep-thu-tuc",
+                    "suggestedTopicLv3Key": "mau-khuyen-mai-thuong-mai",
+                    "confidence": "medium",
+                    "note": "Mẫu thủ tục hội chợ/triển lãm, lệch cụm Kinh nghiệm",
+                }
+            )
+        elif has_any(t, ["bat dong san", "chuyen nhuong du an", "san giao dich", "chung chi hanh nghe moi gioi"]):

+OUT_LEFT_JSON_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage24-manual-review-left.json"
+OUT_LEFT_MD_PATH = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-stage24-manual-review-left.md"

+META_RE = re.compile(

+def load_importer_module():

+def build_taxonomy_maps() -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], List[Dict]]:
+    data = json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "taxonomy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    parent: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    roots = data.get("roots", [])
+    stack: List[Tuple[Dict, str]] = [(node, "") for node in roots]
+    while stack:
+        node, pkey = stack.pop()
+        key = node.get("key") or ""
+        label = node.get("label") or ""
+        if key:
+            labels[key] = label
+            if pkey:
+                parent[key] = pkey
+        for child in node.get("children") or []:
+            stack.append((child, key))
+    return labels, parent, roots

+
+def lv3_belongs_to_lv2(roots: List[Dict], lv2_key: str, lv3_key: str) -> bool:
+    for r in roots:
+        stack = [r]
+        while stack:
+            n = stack.pop()
+            if n.get("key") == lv2_key:
+                child_stack = list(n.get("children") or [])
+                while child_stack:
+                    c = child_stack.pop()
+                    if c.get("key") == lv3_key:
+                        return True
+                    child_stack.extend(c.get("children") or [])
+            stack.extend(n.get("children") or [])
+    return False

+def update_meta(
+    path: Path,
+    lv1_key: str,
+    lv1_label: str,
+    lv2_key: str,
+    lv2_label: str,
+    lv3_key: str,
+    lv3_label: str,
+) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    meta["topicLv1Key"] = lv1_key
+    meta["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_label
+    meta["topicLv2Key"] = lv2_key
+    meta["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_label
+    meta["topicLv3Key"] = lv3_key
+    meta["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_label
+    meta["cardTopicLabel"] = lv2_label
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"

+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:

+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",

+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):

+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)

+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)

+    return {

+def write_final_summary(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> None:
+    final_md = ROOT / "docs" / "lv3-final-summary.md"

+    total = len(imported_rows)
+    non_empty = sum(1 for a in imported_rows if (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip())
+    empty = total - non_empty
+    coverage = round((non_empty / total) * 100, 2) if total else 0.0

+    from collections import Counter
+
+    remaining = [a for a in imported_rows if not (a.get("topicLv3Key") or "").strip() and a.get("section") == "thu-vien"]
+    by_lv2 = Counter((a.get("topicLv2Key") or "") for a in remaining)
+
+    payload = {
